fusions.name: Point-Blank Stoop
fusions.desc: You swoop up to 7 tiles onto an enemy and fire point-blank for 14 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Plunging Fire
fusions.desc: Fires a round in a high arc at an enemy up to 10 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Change of Perch
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, and your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wingshot
fusions.desc: Every few paces you move, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
